cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the house meeting, use that clear speaking voice I taught you. Tell them the bins are Alex's turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you checked the old one. Now practise the update: Alex has Thursday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remembered to ask about consent. Call it a proposal, then. Say you support it; I taught you to offer a solution, not just read out the old rota.
